cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. They're calling your audition number. Do you want the part enough to let them hear you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want it. I don't want them laughing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I can walk you in or drive you home. Which want am I helping?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Walk me in, but promise they won't laugh.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can promise I'll stay. Is that enough to risk the audition, or are we going home?

mechanism: A copies an audition cue incorrectly and keeps confident control while forcing B to choose exposure or safety.
confusable: D106 forces a tradeoff; D103 would recruit hope without requiring the cost be chosen.
comparison: Audition risk versus honest lease discussion.
seedUse: Keep B request for guaranteed safety answered only with presence guarantee.
